(overrides provider-level).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ModelLimits {\n    /// Maximum concurrent workers dispatching to this model.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub max_concurrent: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// Provider/model concurrency and rate limiting configuration.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct LimitsConfig {\n    /// Per-provider limits keyed by provider name (e.g., `anthropic`, `openai`).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub providers: BTreeMap<String, ProviderLimits>,\n    /// Per-model limits keyed by model name (e.g., `claude-opus`).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub models: BTreeMap<String, ModelLimits>,\n}\n\n/// A/B test variant for a prompt template.\n///\n/// Configured under `prompt.variants.<template_name>` in `.needle.yaml`.\n/// Workers are assigned to variants deterministically by `hash(worker_id) % 100`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct VariantConfig {\n    /// Variant name (e.g., `\"control\"`, `\"v2\"`).\n    pub name: String,\n\n    /// Percentage of workers assigned to this variant (0–100).\n    pub weight: u8,\n\n    /// Path to the file containing the variant template content.\n    /// Resolved relative to the workspace root.\n    pub content_file: PathBuf,\n}\n\n/// Prompt construction configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded from the `prompt` section of workspace config (`.needle.yaml`).\n/// Templates can be overridden per-workspace or globally.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct PromptConfig {\n    /// Paths to context files read from the workspace and included in prompts.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub context_files: Vec<PathBuf>,\n\n    /// Free-form instructions appended to every prompt.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub instructions: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Named template overrides. Keys are template names (e.g., `\"pluck\"`,\n    /// `\"mitosis\"`, `\"weave\"`, `\"unravel\"`, `\"pulse\"`). Only the templates\n    /// specified here are overridden; others use built-in defaults.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub templates: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,\n\n    /// A/B test variants per template name.\n    ///\n    /// Keys are template names; values are ordered lists of variants.\n    /// Workers are assigned to variants based on `hash(worker_id) % 100`\n    /// compared against cumulative variant weights.\n    ///\n    /// Example `.needle.yaml`:\n    /// ```yaml\n    /// prompt:\n    ///   variants:\n    ///     pluck:\n    ///       - name: v2\n    ///         weight: 50\n    ///         content_file: prompts/pluck-v2.txt\n    /// ```\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub variants: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Vec<VariantConfig>>,\n}\n\n/// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n///\n/// Controls the :testing → :stable promotion pipeline with canary tests.\n/// When enabled, new versions of needle are tested against a canary workspace\n/// before being promoted to stable.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct SelfModificationConfig {\n    /// Whether self-modification is enabled (default: false).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub enabled: bool,\n\n    /// Path to the canary test workspace containing test beads.\n    /// Defaults to `~/.needle/canary/`.\n    #[serde(default = \"SelfModificationConfig::default_canary_workspace\")]\n    pub canary_workspace: PathBuf,\n\n    /// Automatically promote :testing to :stable when canary passes.\n    /// When false, requires manual `needle promote` command.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub auto_promote: bool,\n\n    /// Maximum time (seconds) to run canary tests before considering it a timeout.\n    #[serde(default = \"SelfModificationConfig::default_canary_timeout\")]\n    pub canary_timeout: u64,\n\n    /// Fleet hot-reloads from :stable between beads (default: true).\n    /// When enabled, workers check for a new :stable binary after each bead\n    /// cycle and re-exec if a different binary is detected.\n    #[serde(default = \"SelfModificationConfig::default_hot_reload\")]\n    pub hot_reload: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for SelfModificationConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        SelfModificationConfig {\n            enabled: false,\n            canary_workspace: Self::default_canary_workspace(),\n            auto_promote: false,\n            canary_timeout: Self::default_canary_timeout(),\n            hot_reload: Self::default_hot_reload(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SelfModificationConfig {\n    fn default_canary_workspace() -> PathBuf {\n        dirs_or_home(\".needle/canary\")\n    }\n\n    fn default_canary_timeout() -> u64 {\n        300 // 5 minutes\n    }\n\n    fn default_hot_reload() -> bool {\n        true\n    }\n}\n\n/// FABRIC telemetry forwarding configuration.\n///\n/// When enabled, NEEDLE workers POST structured events to the FABRIC\n/// web server (`fabric web`) for live dashboard display.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct FabricConfig {\n    /// Whether to forward events to FABRIC (default: /// Request timeout in seconds (default: 2).\n    #[serde(default = \"FabricConfig::default_timeout\")]\n    pub timeout: u64,\n\n    /// Batch events before sending instead of sending one at a time (default: false).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub batching: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for FabricConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        FabricConfig {\n            enabled: false,\n            endpoint: String::new(),\n            timeout: Self::default_timeout(),\n            batching: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl FabricConfig {\n    fn default_timeout() -> u64 {\n        2\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config Source Tracking\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Subset of configuration that can be overridden per-workspace via `.needle.yaml`.\n///\n/// Only these sections are allowed at the workspace level:\n/// - `agent.default`, `agent.timeout`\n/// - `strands` (weave, pulse, unravel)\n/// - `prompt.*`\n/// - `verification` (legacy) or `gates` (new pluggable system)\n///\n/// Non-overridable sections (worker, limits, health, telemetry) are detected\n/// and produce warnings.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceOverrides {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: Option<WorkspaceAgentOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: Option<WorkspaceStrandsOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: Option<PromptConfig>,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Option<Vec<String>>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Option<Vec<GateConfig>>,\n    /// Workspace identity labels (overridable per-workspace).\n    ///\n    /// Set in `.needle.yaml` under `workspace.labels`. Used for cross-workspace\n    /// skill sharing: skills from Explore workspaces whose labels overlap with\n    /// these labels are injected into prompts alongside local skills.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: Option<WorkspaceLabelsOverride>,\n}\n\n/// Agent fields overridable at the workspace level.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceAgentOverrides {\n    pub default: Option<String>,\n    pub timeout: Option<u64>,\n    pub routing: Option<RoutingConfig>,\n}\n\n/// Strand fields overridable at the workspace level.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorkspaceStrandsOverrides {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub weave: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub pulse: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub unravel: Option<serde_yaml::Value>,\n}\n\n/// Non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config.\n///\n/// Note: `workspace` is intentionally absent — `workspace.labels` IS overridable\n/// per-workspace. The path fields (`default`, `home`) are simply ignored if set.\nconst NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS: &[&str] = &[\"worker\", \"limits\", \"health\", \"telemetry\"];\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Top-level Config\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fully resolved NEEDLE configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded once at boot, immutable during a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Config {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: AgentConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub worker: WorkerConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: WorkspaceConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: StrandsConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency and rate limits.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub limits: LimitsConfig,\n    /// Per-model token pricing (USD per million tokens).\n    #[serde(default = \"crate::cost::default_pricing\")]\n    pub pricing: PricingConfig,\n    /// Daily budget thresholds for cost enforcement.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub budget: BudgetConfig,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Vec<String>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC live dashboard forwarding.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub fabric: FabricConfig,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", self.field, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CLI overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// CLI-level overrides applied after all file-based config loading.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct CliOverrides {\n    pub workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    pub worker_name: Option<String>,\n    pub agent_binary: Option<String>,\n    pub max_workers: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ConfigLoader\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global config from `~/.config/needle/config.yaml`.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config (not an error).\n    pub fn load_global() -> Result<Config> {\n        let path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        Self::load_from_path(&path)\n    }\n\n    /// Load config from a specific path.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config.\n    pub fn load_from_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Config> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(Config::default());\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        let config: Config = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load workspace overrides from `.needle.yaml` in the given workspace root.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if the file does not exist. Emits warnings for\n    /// non-overridable keys found in the workspace config.\n    pub fn load_workspace(workspace_root: &Path) -> Result<Option<WorkspaceOverrides>> {\n        let path = workspace_root.join(\".needle.yaml\");\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        // Check for non-overridable keys and warn.\n        Self::warn_non_overridable_keys(&text, &path)?;\n\n        let overrides: WorkspaceOverrides = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(Some(overrides))\n    }\n\n    /// Warn about non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config YAML.\n    fn warn_non_overridable_keys(yaml_text: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let value: serde_yaml::Value = serde_yaml::from_str(yaml_text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        if let serde_yaml::Value::Mapping(map) = value {\n            for key in map.keys() {\n                if let serde_yaml::Value::String(key_str) = key {\n                    if NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS.contains(&key_str.as_str()) {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            key = %key_str,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            \"workspace config contains non-overridable setting '{}' — ignored\",\n                            key_str,\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Apply workspace overrides to a config.\n    ///\n    /// Only overridable fields are applied. Records sources in the source map.\n    pub fn apply_workspace(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: &WorkspaceOverrides,\n        ws_path: &Path,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        let source = ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(ws_path.join(\".needle.yaml\"));\n\n        if let Some(ref agent) = overrides.agent {\n            if let Some(ref default) = agent.default {\n                config.agent.default = default.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(timeout) = agent.timeout {\n                config.agent.timeout = timeout;\n                sources.insert(\"agent.timeout\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref routing) = agent.routing {\n                config.agent.routing = Some(routing.clone());\n                sources.insert(\"agent.routing\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref strands) = overrides.strands {\n            if let Some(ref weave_val) = strands.weave {\n                if let Ok(weave_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<WeaveConfig>(weave_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.weave = weave_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.weave\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref pulse_val) = strands.pulse {\n                if let Ok(pulse_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<PulseConfig>(pulse_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.pulse = pulse_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.pulse\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref unravel_val) = strands.unravel {\n                if let Ok(unravel_cfg) =\n                    serde_yaml::from_value::<UnravelConfig>(unravel_val.clone())\n                {\n                    config.strands.unravel = unravel_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.unravel\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref prompt) = overrides.prompt {\n            config.prompt = prompt.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.context_files\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.instructions\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref verification) = overrides.verification {\n            config.verification = verification.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"verification\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref gates) = overrides.gates {\n            config.gates = gates.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"gates\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            if !ws.labels.is_empty() {\n                config.workspace.labels = ws.labels.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"workspace.labels\".to_string(), source);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply environment variable overrides (`NEEDLE_*` prefix, `__` separator).\n    ///\n    /// Example: `NEEDLE_AGENT__DEFAULT=opus` sets `agent.default` to `\"opus\"`.\n    pub fn apply_env_overrides(config: &mut Config, sources: &mut SourceMap) {\n        for (key, value) in std::env::vars() {\n            if let Some(suffix) = key.strip_prefix(\"NEEDLE_\") {\n                let config_path = suffix.to_lowercase().replace(\"__\", \".\");\n                let source = ConfigSource::EnvVar(key.clone());\n\n                match config_path.as_str() {\n                    \"agent.default\" => {\n                        config.agent.default = value;\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"agent.timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.agent.timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for agent.timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"agent.routing.default_adapter\" => {\n                        config\n                            .agent\n                            .routing\n                            .get_or_insert_with(RoutingConfig::default)\n                            .default_adapter = Some(value);\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"worker.max_workers\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u32>() {\n                            config.worker.max_workers = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.max_workers — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.idle_timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.idle_timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.idle_timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.launch_stagger_seconds — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for health.heartbeat_interval_secs — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for health.heartbeat_ttl_secs — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.enabled\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<bool>() {\n                            config.self_modification.enabled = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.enabled — expected true/false\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.auto_promote\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<bool>() {\n                            config.self_modification.auto_promote = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.auto_promote — expected true/false\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.canary_timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.self_modification.canary_timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.canary_timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        tracing::debug!(\n                            env_var = %key,\n                            config_path = %config_path,\n                            \"unrecognized NEEDLE_ environment variable — ignored\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply CLI overrides (highest precedence) to a loaded config.\n    pub fn apply_overrides(config: &mut Config, overrides: CliOverrides) {\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(config, overrides, &mut SourceMap::new());\n    }\n\n    /// Apply CLI overrides with source tracking.\n    pub fn apply_cli_overrides(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: CliOverrides,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        if let Some(ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            config.workspace.default = ws;\n            sources.insert(\"workspace.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(agent) = overrides.agent_binary {\n            config.agent.default = agent;\n            sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(n) = overrides.max_workers {\n            config.worker.max_workers = n;\n            sources.insert(\"worker.max_workers\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        // worker_name is handled at the Worker level, not stored in Config\n    }\n\n    /// Load the fully resolved configuration using the complete hierarchy:\n    ///\n    /// defaults → global file → workspace `.needle.yaml` → env vars → CLI args\n    ///\n    /// Returns the resolved config and a source map showing where each value\n    /// came from. The source map only contains entries for values that were\n    /// overridden from their defaults.\n    pub fn load_resolved(workspace_root: &Path, cli: CliOverrides) -> Result<(Config, SourceMap)> {\n        let mut sources = SourceMap::new();\n\n        // Layer 1 + 2: defaults + global config.\n        let global_path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        let mut config = Self::load_from_path(&global_path)?;\n\n        // Track which fields came from global config (if file existed).\n        if global_path.exists() {\n            let source = ConfigSource::GlobalFile(global_path);\n            // Mark all top-level sections as from global.\n            for key in &[\n                \"agent.default\",\n                \"agent.timeout\",\n                \"worker.max_workers\",\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n            ] {\n                sources.insert((*key).to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Layer 3: workspace config.\n        if let Some(ws_overrides) = Self::load_workspace(workspace_root)? {\n            Self::apply_workspace(&mut config, &ws_overrides, workspace_root, &mut sources);\n        }\n\n        // Layer 4: environment variables.\n        Self::apply_env_overrides(&mut config, &mut sources);\n\n        // Layer 5: CLI arguments.\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(&mut config, cli, &mut sources);\n\n        Ok((config, sources))\n    }\n\n    /// Validate a resolved config.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of errors (empty = valid).\n    pub fn validate(config: &Config) -> Vec<ConfigError> {\n        let mut errors = ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global config from `~/.config/needle/config.yaml`.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config (not an error).\n    pub fn load_global() -> Result<Config> {\n        let path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        Self::load_from_path(&path)\n    }\n\n    /// Load config from a specific path.\n    ///\n    /// If the file does not exist, returns the default config.\n    pub fn load_from_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Config> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(Config::default());\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        let config: Config = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load workspace overrides from `.needle.yaml` in the given workspace root.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if the file does not exist. Emits warnings for\n    /// non-overridable keys found in the workspace config.\n    pub fn load_workspace(workspace_root: &Path) -> Result<Option<WorkspaceOverrides>> {\n        let path = workspace_root.join(\".needle.yaml\");\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        // Check for non-overridable keys and warn.\n        Self::warn_non_overridable_keys(&text, &path)?;\n\n        let overrides: WorkspaceOverrides = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(Some(overrides))\n    }\n\n    /// Warn about non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config YAML.\n    fn warn_non_overridable_keys(yaml_text: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let value: serde_yaml::Value = serde_yaml::from_str(yaml_text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        if let serde_yaml::Value::Mapping(map) = value {\n            for key in map.keys() {\n                if let serde_yaml::Value::String(key_str) = key {\n                    if NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS.contains(&key_str.as_str()) {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            key = %key_str,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            \"workspace config contains non-overridable setting '{}' — ignored\",\n                            key_str,\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Apply workspace overrides to a config.\n    ///\n    /// Only overridable fields are applied. Records sources in the source map.\n    pub fn apply_workspace(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: &WorkspaceOverrides,\n        ws_path: &Path,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        let source = ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(ws_path.join(\".needle.yaml\"));\n\n        if let Some(ref agent) = overrides.agent {\n            if let Some(ref default) = agent.default {\n                config.agent.default = default.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(timeout) = agent.timeout {\n                config.agent.timeout = timeout;\n                sources.insert(\"agent.timeout\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref routing) = agent.routing {\n                config.agent.routing = Some(routing.clone());\n                sources.insert(\"agent.routing\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref strands) = overrides.strands {\n            if let Some(ref weave_val) = strands.weave {\n                if let Ok(weave_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<WeaveConfig>(weave_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.weave = weave_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.weave\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref pulse_val) = strands.pulse {\n                if let Ok(pulse_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<PulseConfig>(pulse_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.pulse = pulse_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.pulse\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref unravel_val) = strands.unravel {\n                if let Ok(unravel_cfg) =\n                    serde_yaml::from_value::<UnravelConfig>(unravel_val.clone())\n                {\n                    config.strands.unravel = unravel_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.unravel\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref prompt) = overrides.prompt {\n            config.prompt = prompt.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.context_files\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.instructions\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref verification) = overrides.verification {\n            config.verification = verification.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"verification\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref gates) = overrides.gates {\n            config.gates = gates.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"gates\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            if !ws.labels.is_empty() {\n                config.workspace.labels = ws.labels.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"workspace.labels\".to_string(), source);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply environment variable overrides (`NEEDLE_*` prefix, `__` separator).\n    ///\n    /// Example: `NEEDLE_AGENT__DEFAULT=opus` sets `agent.default` to `\"opus\"`.\n    pub fn apply_env_overrides(config: &mut Config, sources: &mut SourceMap) {\n        for (key, value) in std::env::vars() {\n            if let Some(suffix) = key.strip_prefix(\"NEEDLE_\") {\n                let config_path = suffix.to_lowercase().replace(\"__\", \".\");\n                let source = ConfigSource::EnvVar(key.clone());\n\n           }\n                    \"agent.timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.agent.timeout = v;\n             \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.launch_stagger_seconds — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                   );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for                  if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<bool>() {\n                            config.self_modification.auto_promote = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.auto_promote — expected true/false\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"self_modification.canary_timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.self_modification.canary_timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for self_modification.canary_timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        tracing::debug!(\n                            env_var = %key,\n                            config_path = %config_path,\n                            \"unrecognized NEEDLE_ environment variable — ignored\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply CLI overrides (highest precedence) to a loaded config.\n    pub fn apply_overrides(config: &mut Config, overrides: CliOverrides) {\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(config, overrides, &mut SourceMap::new());\n    }\n\n    /// Apply CLI overrides with source tracking.\n    pub fn apply_cli_overrides(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: CliOverrides,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        if let Some(ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            config.workspace.default = ws;\n            sources.insert(\"workspace.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(agent) = overrides.agent_binary {\n            config.agent.default = agent;\n            sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(n) = overrides.max_workers {\n            config.worker.max_workers = n;\n            sources.insert(\"worker.max_workers\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        // worker_name is handled at the Worker level, not stored in Config\n    }\n\n    /// Load the fully resolved configuration using the complete hierarchy:\n    ///\n    /// defaults → global file → workspace `.needle.yaml` → env vars → CLI args\n    ///\n    /// Returns the resolved config and a source map showing where each value\n    /// came from. The source map only contains entries for values that were\n    /// overridden from their defaults.\n    pub fn load_resolved(workspace_root: &Path, cli: CliOverrides) -> Result<(Config, SourceMap)> {\n        let mut sources = SourceMap::new();\n\n        // Layer 1 + 2: defaults + global config.\n        let global_path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        let mut config = Self::load_from_path(&global_path)?;\n\n        // Track which fields came from global config (if file existed).\n        if global_path.exists() {\n            let source = ConfigSource::GlobalFile(global_path);\n            // Mark all top-level sections as from global.\n            for key in &[\n                \"agent.default\",\n                \"agent.timeout\",\n                \"worker.max_workers\",\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n            ] {\n                sources.insert((*key).to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Layer 3: workspace config.\n        if let Some(ws_overrides) = Self::load_workspace(workspace_root)? {\n            Self::apply_workspace(&mut config, &ws_overrides, workspace_root, &mut sources);\n        }\n\n        // Layer 4: environment variables.\n        Self::apply_env_overrides(&mut config, &mut sources);\n\n        // Layer 5: CLI arguments.\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(&mut config, cli, &mut sources);\n\n        Ok((config, sources))\n    }\n\n    /// Validate a resolved config.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of errors (empty = valid).\n    pub fn validate(config: &Config) -> Vec<ConfigError> {\n        let mut errors = Vec::new();\n\n        if config.agent.default.is_empty() {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"agent.default\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must not be empty\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.max_workers == 0 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.max_workers\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must be at least 1\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.max_workers > 50 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.max_workers\".to_string(),\n                message: format!(\n                    \"{} exceeds practical fleet limit of 50\",\n                    config.worker.max_workers\n                ),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.cpu_load_warn <= 0.0 || config.worker.cpu_load_warn > 1.0 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.cpu_load_warn\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must be in range (0.0, 1.0]\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs < 3 * config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\".to_string(),\n                message: format!(\n                    \"should be >= 3 * heartbeat_interval_secs ({}); detection may be unreliable\",\n                    3 * config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs\n                ),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Validate routing regex patterns.\n        if let Some(ref routing) = config.agent.routing {\n            for (idx, rule) in routing.rules.iter().enumerate() {\n                // Validate that match_model is a valid regex.\n                if let Err(e) = regex::Regex::new(&rule.match_model) {\n                    errors.push(ConfigError {\n                        field: format!(\"agent.routing.rules[{}].match_model\", idx),\n                        message: format!(\"invalid regex pattern '{}': {}\", rule.match_model, e),\n                    });\n                }\n                // Validate that adapter is not empty.\n                if rule.adapter.is_empty() {\n                    errors.push(ConfigError {\n                        field: format!(\"agent.routing.rules[{}].adapter\", idx),\n                        message: \"must not be empty\".to_string(),\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        errors\n    }\n\n    /// Format config values with source annotations for `--dump --show-source`.\n    pub fn dump_with_sources(config: &Config, sources: &SourceMap) -> Vec<String> {\n        let fields: Vec<(&str, String)> = vec![\n            (\"agent.default\", config.agent.default.clone()),\n            (\"agent.timeout\", config.agent.timeout.to_string()),\n            (\"worker.max_workers\", config.worker.max_workers.to_string()),\n            (\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                config.worker.idle_timeout.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\",\n                config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n                config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"prompt.context_files\",\n                format!(\"{:?}\", config.prompt.context_files),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"prompt.instructions\",\n                config\n                    .prompt\n                    .instructions\n                    .as_deref()\n                    .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                    .to_string(),\n            ),\n        ];\n\n        fields\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(key, value)| {\n                let source = sources.get(key).cloned().unwrap_or(ConfigSource::Default);\n                format!(\"{}: {} (from: {})\", key, value, source)\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Resolve a path relative to the user's home directory.\nfn dirs_or_home(relative: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n        PathBuf::from(home).join(relative)\n    } else {\n        PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\").join(relative)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// std::fs::write(\n            dir.path().join(\".needle.yaml\"),\n            \"agent:\\n  default: workspace-agent\\n  timeout: 777\\n\",\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n\n        let cli = WorkerState::Dispatching\n                    | WorkerState::Executing\n                    | WorkerState::Handling => {\n                        // Release any claimed bead before stopping.\n                        self.release_current_bead(&reason).await;\n                        return self.stop(&reason).await;\n                    }\n                    // For states where we don't hold a bead, stop immediately.\n                    WorkerState::Selecting\n                    | WorkerState::Claiming\n                    | WorkerState::Retrying\n                    | WorkerState::Logging => {\n                        // Release any claimed bead before stopping (should be none in these states).\n                        self.release_current_bead(&reason).await;\n                        return self.stop(&reason).await;\n                    }\n                    WorkerState::Stopped | WorkerState::Exhausted | WorkerState::Errored => {\n                        return self.stop(&reason).await;\n                    }\n                    WorkerState::Booting => {\n                        return self.stop(\"signal received during boot\").await;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Check for watchdog trigger - this indicates HANDLING state is wedged.\n            // The watchdog runs in a separate thread and can detect when the worker\n            // is stuck even if the Tokio runtime becomes unresponsive.\n            if self.watchdog_triggered.load(Ordering::Relaxed)\n                && self.state == WorkerState::Handling\n            {\n                tracing::error!(\"watchdog detected HANDLING state hang, forcing recovery\");\n                // Emit critical timeout event.\n                let bead_id = self.current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.id.clone());\n                let _ = self\n                    .telemetry\n                    .emit_try_lock(EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                        bead_id: bead_id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| BeadId::from(\"unknown\")),\n                        outcome: \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        operation: \"watchdog\".to_string(),\n                        error: format!(\n                            \"HANDLING state exceeded {}s timeout\",\n                            HANDLING_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SECS\n                        ),\n                    });\n                // Attempt best-effort release if we have a bead.\n                if let Some(ref bead) = self.current_bead {\n                    let bead_id = bead.id.clone();\n                    tracing::warn!(bead_id = %bead_id, \"best-effort bead release due to watchdog timeout\");\n                    let _ =\n                        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.store.release(&bead_id))\n                            .await;\n                }\n                // Clear the watchdog trigger and force transition to LOGGING.\n                self.watchdog_triggered.store(false, Ordering::Release);\n                self.handling_state_entered_at = None;\n                // Force transition to LOGGING to recover.\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Logging)?;\n            }\n\n            match self.state {\n                WorkerState::Selecting => self.do_select().await?,\n                WorkerState::Claiming => self.do_claim().await?,\n                WorkerState::Retrying => self.do_retry().await?,\n                WorkerState::Building => self.do_build().await?,\n                WorkerState::Dispatching => self.do_dispatch().await?,\n                WorkerState::Executing => self.do_execute().await?,\n                WorkerState::Handling => self.do_handle().await?,\n                WorkerState::Logging => self.do_log()?,\n                WorkerState::Exhausted => {\n                    let next = self.handle_exhausted().await?;\n                    match next {\n                        WorkerState::Selecting => continue,\n                        terminal => return Ok(terminal),\n                    }\n                }\n                WorkerState::Stopped => {\n                    return self.stop(\"normal shutdown\").await;\n                }\n                WorkerState::Errored => {\n                    let err = self\n                        .last_error\n                        .take()\n                        .unwrap_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"unknown error\"));\n                    let msg = format!(\"{err}\");\n                    self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerErrored {\n                        error_type: \"worker_scoped\".to_string(),\n                        error_message: msg.clone(),\n                        beads_processed: self.beads_processed,\n                    })?;\n\n                    // Emit WorkerStopped before exiting so telemetry shows a clean shutdown.\n                    // This ensures operators can distinguish \"exited with error\" from\n                    // \"killed by external agent\" (e.g., SIGKILL, OOM).\n                    let uptime = self.boot_time.map(|t| t.elapsed().as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);\n                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerStopped {\n                        reason: format!(\"error: {msg}\"),\n                        beads_processed: self.beads_processed,\n                        uptime_secs: uptime,\n                    });\n\n                    // Best-effort stop heartbeat on error.\n                    self.health.stop();\n                    // Best-effort deregister on error.\n                    if let Err(e) = self.registry.deregister(&self.qualified_id()) {\n                        tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to deregister from worker registry on error\");\n                    }\n                    self.telemetry.shutdown().await;\n                    return Err(err);\n                }\n                WorkerState::Booting => {\n                    bail!(\"boot() should have transitioned past Booting state\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ── Boot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Validate configuration and initialize the worker.\n    ///\n    /// Each step is instrumented with `init.step.started`/`init.step.completed`\n    /// events so that hangs are visible in the telemetry log. Boot duration is\n    /// capped at 60 seconds — if exceeded, the worker self-aborts with a\n    /// `worker.boot.timeout` event and exits with a non-zero code.\n    fn boot(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.boot_time = Some(Instant::now());\n        const BOOT_TIMEOUT_SECS: u64 = 60;\n\n        // Step: Config validation\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n            step: \"config_validation\".to_string(),\n        })?;\n        let step_start = Instant::now();\n        let errors = ConfigLoader::validate(&self.config);\n        if !errors.is_empty() {\n            let msg = errors\n                .iter()\n                .map(|e| e.to_string())\n                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                .join(\"; \");\n            bail!(\"config validation failed: {msg}\");\n        }\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n            step: \"config_validation\".to_string(),\n            duration_ms: step_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,\n        })?;\n\n        // Check boot timeout before each step\n        self.check_boot_timeout(BOOT_TIMEOUT_SECS)?;\n\n        // Step: Registry registration\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n            step: \"registry_registration\".to_string(),\n        })?;\n        let step_start = Instant::now();\n        let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", self.config.agent.default, self.worker_name);\n        let entry = WorkerEntry {\n            id: qualified_id.clone(),\n            pid: std::process::id(),\n            workspace: self.config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            agent: self.config.agent.default.clone(),\n            model: None,\n            provider: self.resolve_provider(),\n            started_at: chrono::Utc::now(),\n            beads_processed: 0,\n        };\n        if let Err(e) = self.registry.register(entry) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to register in worker registry\");\n        }\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n            step: \"registry_registration\".to_string(),\n            duration_ms: step_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,\n        })?;\n\n        // Check boot timeout before each step\n        self.check_boot_timeout(BOOT_TIMEOUT_SECS)?;\n\n        // Step: Heartbeat emitter start\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n            step: \"heartbeat_emitter\".to_string(),\n        })?;\n        let step_start = Instant::now();\n        if let Err(e) = self.health.start_emitter() {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to start heartbeat emitter\");\n        }\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n            step: \"heartbeat_emitter\".to_string(),\n            duration_ms: step_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,\n        })?;\n\n        // Emit worker started event — boot complete\n        self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerStarted {\n            worker_name: self.worker_name.clone(),\n            version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n        })?;\n\n        self.set_state(WorkerState::Selecting)?;\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker = %self.worker_name,\n            strands = ?self.strands.strand_names(),\n            \"worker booted\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Check if boot has exceeded the timeout and abort if so.\n    ///\n    /// Emits `worker.boot.timeout` and exits the process with a non-zero\n    /// code. This is a last-resort measure when an init step hangs.\n    fn check_boot_timeout(&self, timeout_secs: u64) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(boot_start) = self.boot_time {\n            let elapsed = boot_start.elapsed();\n            if elapsed.as_secs() > timeout_secs {\n                let elapsed_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as u64;\n                // Emit the timeout event before aborting\n                let _ = self\n                    .telemetry\n                    .emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms });\n                tracing::error!(\n                    elapsed_ms,\n                    \"boot timeout exceeded {}s — aborting\",\n                    timeout_secs\n                );\n                // Flush telemetry before exit\n                std::mem::forget(self.telemetry.clone());\n                // Exit with a distinct code to indicate boot timeout\n                std::process::exit(71); // EX_OSERR + custom offset\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Signal handling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Install SIGINT, SIGTERM, and SIGHUP handlers that set the shutdown flag.\n    ///\n    /// SIGHUP is handled because when the parent bash dies (e.g., tmux session\n    /// killed, external reaper), the child process receives SIGHUP by default.\n    /// Without a handler, the process terminates immediately without emitting\n    /// worker.stopped telemetry or flushing the telemetry buffer.\n    ///\n    /// Uses synchronous signal handlers via libc/signal-hook to ensure signals\n    /// are caught immediately, even if the tokio runtime hasn't polled async\n    /// signal tasks yet. This prevents silent process termination when signals\n    /// arrive early (e.g., SIGHUP from parent bash death during worker startup).\n    fn install_signal_handlers(&self) {\n        // Store a global reference to the shutdown flag for signal handlers.\n        // We use a leak to ensure the reference lives for the entire program duration.\n        let shutdown_ptr = Arc::into_raw(self.shutdown.clone()) as usize;\n        set_global_shutdown_flag(shutdown_ptr);\n\n        // Register atexit handler to emit worker.stopped telemetry on unexpected termination.\n        // This provides diagnostic information when the worker is killed by an external\n        // process (e.g., capacity governor, OOM killer, SIGKILL).\n        let start_time = self.boot_time.unwrap_or_else(Instant::now);\n        register_atexit_handler(\n            self.worker_name.clone(),\n            self.beads_processed,\n            start_time,\n            format!(\"{:?}\", self.state),\n            None, // log_file_path - not available during boot\n        );\n\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            // Install synchronous signal handlers using libc.\n            // These handlers are called immediately when the signal is received,\n            // before the tokio runtime has a chance to process any async tasks.\n            unsafe {\n                install_unix_signal_handlers();\n            }\n        }\n\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            // On non-Unix platforms, use tokio's ctrl_c handler.\n            let shutdown_int = self.shutdown.clone();\n            tokio::spawn(async move {\n                if tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await.is_ok() {\n                    tracing::info!(\"received SIGINT, initiating graceful shutdown\");\n                    shutdown_int.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);\n                }\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ── State handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// SELECTING: run strand waterfall to find a candidate bead.\n    async fn do_select(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        // Clear per-cycle state.\n        // Preserve race-lost exclusions with TTL and beads that lost a race in the current cycle.\n        // NOTE: Do NOT reset retry_count or consecutive_race_lost here — they must\n        // accumulate across cycles to prevent infinite race-lost loops (see needle-aad8).\n        self.race_lost_this_cycle.clear();\n        self.current_bead = None;\n        self.current_strand = None;\n\n        // Restore home store if it was swapped for a remote workspace.\n        self.restore_home_store();\n\n        // Update heartbeat with home workspace (not current_workspace which\n        // might be stale). This ensures heartbeat reports correctly even if\n        // restore_home_store() was a no-op (stores already equal).\n        self.health.update_state(\n            &WorkerState::Selecting,\n            None,\n            Some(self.config.workspace.default.as_path()),\n        );\n\n        // Try atomic claim_auto first (server-selected bead in one transaction).\n        // This eliminates the race condition where two workers both see the same\n        // bead in ready() and race to claim it.\n        let strand = \"auto\";\n        let claim = self.claimer.claim_auto(&self.qualified_id(), strand).await;\n\n        match claim {\n            Ok(ClaimResult::Claimed(bead)) => {\n                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, \"atomically claimed bead via claim_auto\");\n                self.current_bead = Some(bead);\n                self.current_strand = Some(strand.to_string());\n                self.consecutive_race_lost = 0;\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Building)?;\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable { reason }) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    reason,\n                    \"claim_auto returned no beads, falling back to strand waterfall\"\n                );\n                // Fall through to strand waterfall\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"claim_auto failed, falling back to strand waterfall\");\n                // Fall through to strand waterfall\n            }\n            Ok(other) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    ?other,\n                    \"claim_auto returned unexpected result, falling back to strand waterfall\"\n                );\n                // Fall through to strand waterfall\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Fallback: run strand waterfall to find a candidate bead.\n        let exclusions = self.current_exclusions();\n        let candidate = self\n            .strands\n            .select(self.store.as_ref(), &exclusions)\n            .await?;\n        self.last_waterfall_restarts = candidate.waterfall_restarts;\n        self.last_restart_triggers = candidate.restart_triggers.clone();\n        self.last_strand_evaluations = candidate\n            .strand_evaluations\n            .iter()\n            .map(|e| (e.strand_name.clone(), e.result.clone(), e.duration_ms))\n            .collect();\n\n        match candidate.bead {\n            Some((bead, strand_name)) => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead.id, strand = %strand_name, \"candidate found\");\n\n                // If the bead is from a remote workspace (found by Explore),\n                // swap the active store so claim/show/release operate on the\n                // correct workspace. Only switch if the workspace has a real\n                // .beads/ directory — avoids false triggers from mock/stub beads.\n                let bead_ws = bead.workspace.clone();\n                if !is_workspace_unset(&bead_ws)\n                    && bead_ws != self.config.workspace.default\n                    && bead_ws.join(\".beads\").is_dir()\n                {\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        remote_workspace = %bead_ws.display(),\n                        \"bead is from remote workspace, switching store\"\n                    );\n                    self.switch_store_to(&bead_ws)?;\n                }\n\n                // Always update current_workspace to reflect the bead's workspace.\n                // For local beads, this keeps heartbeat consistent with home workspace.\n                // For cross-workspace beads, this ensures heartbeat reports where\n                // the work is actually happening.\n                if !is_workspace_unset(&bead_ws) {\n                    self.current_workspace = bead_ws.clone();\n                }\n\n                self.current_bead = Some(bead);\n                self.current_strand = Some(strand_name);\n\n                // Update heartbeat immediately with the bead's workspace so that\n                // observers see the correct workspace even before transitioning to\n                // CLAIMING. This ensures heartbeats are accurate for cross-workspace\n                // work (see bead needle-c63c).\n                self.health.update_state(\n                    &WorkerState::Selecting,\n                    Some(&self.current_bead.as_ref().unwrap().id),\n                    Some(&bead_ws),\n                );\n\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Claiming)?;\n            }\n            None => {\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Exhausted)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Swap the active bead store to a remote workspace.\n    ///\n    /// Creates a new BrCliBeadStore and rebuilds the Claimer to use it.\n    /// The home store is restored at the start of the next select cycle.\n    fn switch_store_to(&mut self, workspace: &std::path::Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let remote_store = Arc::new(\n            crate::bead_store::BrCliBeadStore::discover(workspace.to_path_buf())\n                .context(\"failed to create bead store for remote workspace\")?,\n        );\n        self.store = remote_store.clone();\n        self.current_workspace = workspace.to_path_buf();\n        self.claimer = Claimer::new(\n            remote_store,\n            std::path::PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\"),\n            self.config.worker.max_claim_retries,\n            100,\n            self.telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n        // Update registry so observers see the actual workspace being processed.\n        if let Err(e) = self\n            .registry\n            .update_workspace(&self.qualified_id(), workspace)\n        {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to update registry workspace\");\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Restore the home workspace store if it was swapped for a remote bead.\n    fn restore_home_store(&mut self) {\n        if !Arc::ptr_eq(&self.store, &self.home_store) {\n            tracing::debug!(\"restoring home workspace store\");\n            self.store = self.home_store.clone();\n            self.current_workspace = self.config.workspace.default.clone();\n            self.claimer = Claimer::new(\n                self.home_store.clone(),\n                std::path::PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\"),\n                self.config.worker.max_claim_retries,\n                100,\n                self.telemetry.clone(),\n            );\n            // Update registry to reflect return to home workspace.\n            if let Err(e) = self\n                .registry\n                .update_workspace(&self.qualified_id(), &self.config.workspace.default)\n            {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to update registry workspace\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// CLAIMING: attempt to claim the selected bead.\n    async fn do_claim(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let bead_id = match self.current_bead {\n            Some(ref b) => b.id.clone(),\n            None => {\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Selecting)?;\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Build the current exclusion set and pass it to claim_one. This\n        // prevents claim_one from attempting to claim a bead that was\n        // just race-lost (which would cause a tight loop).\n        let exclusions = self.current_exclusions();\n        let strand = self.current_strand.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unknown\");\n\n        // Create the bead.claim span that wraps the claim operation.\n        // Note: This span is a child of strand.{name}, not bead.lifecycle,\n        // because bead.lifecycle is only created after the claim succeeds.\n        let claim_span = tracing::info_span!(\n            \"bead.claim\",\n            needle.bead.id = %bead_id.as_ref(),\n            needle.claim.retry_number = tracing::field::Empty,\n            needle.claim.result = tracing::field::Empty,\n        );\n        let _claim_enter = claim_span.enter();\n\n        // Record the initial retry number (will be updated by claim module)\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.claim.retry_number\", 1u32);\n\n        let claim = self\n            .claimer\n            .claim_one(&bead_id, &self.qualified_id(), &exclusions, Some(strand))\n            .await?;\n\n        match claim {\n            ClaimResult::Claimed(mut bead) => {\n                tracing::info!(bead_id = %bead.id, title = %bead.title, \"claimed bead\");\n                self.consecutive_race_lost = 0;\n                self.retry_count = 0;\n                self.clear_all_exclusions();\n                // Preserve the workspace from the pre-claim bead (set by\n                // Explore for remote beads). The claimed bead from br's JSON\n                // returns source_repo as \".\" (cwd-relative), so we treat empty\n                // or \".\" as unset and restore from the pre-claim bead.\n                if is_workspace_unset(&bead.workspace) {\n                    if let Some(ref pre_claim) = self.current_bead {\n                        if !is_workspace_unset(&pre_claim.workspace) {\n                            bead.workspace = pre_claim.workspace.clone();\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                self.current_bead = Some(bead);\n                // Start effort tracking for this cycle.\n                self.last_effort = Some(EffortData {\n                    cycle_start: Instant::now(),\n                    agent_name: String::new(),\n                    model: None,\n                    tokens: dispatch::TokenUsage::default(),\n                    estimated_cost_usd: None,\n                });\n\n                // Compute bead metadata for the lifecycle span.\n                let bead_priority = self.current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.priority);\n                let bead_title_hash = self.current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| {\n                    use std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher;\n                    use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};\n                    let mut hasher = DefaultHasher::new();\n                    b.title.hash(&mut hasher);\n                    format!(\"{:x}\", hasher.finish())\n                });\n\n                // Create the bead.lifecycle span after the claim succeeds.\n                // This span will remain active for the entire bead processing.\n                let lifecycle_span = tracing::info_span!(\n                    \"bead.lifecycle\",\n                    needle.bead.id = %self.current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.id.as_ref()).unwrap_or(\"unknown\"),\n                    needle.bead.priority = bead_priority.unwrap_or(0),\n                    needle.bead.title_hash = %bead_title_hash.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unknown\"),\n                    needle.bead.outcome = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set on completion\n                );\n                self.bead_lifecycle_span = Some(lifecycle_span.entered());\n\n                // Note: The claim_span (_claim_enter) is dropped here, closing the bead.claim span.\n                // The bead.lifecycle span is now active and will be the parent for subsequent operations.\n\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Building)?;\n            }\n            ClaimResult::RaceLost { claimed_by } => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead_id, %claimed_by, \"claim race lost\");\n                // Set the claim span result attribute\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.claim.result\", \"race_lost\");\n                // Set Error status on the claim span\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", \"race_lost\");\n                // Add to race-lost exclusions with TTL (persists across cycles)\n                let expires = Instant::now() + RACE_LOST_EXCLUSION_TTL;\n                self.race_lost_exclusions.push((bead_id.clone(), expires));\n                // Also add to exclusion_set for immediate protection in the current cycle\n                self.exclusion_set.insert(bead_id.clone());\n                self.race_lost_this_cycle.insert(bead_id);\n                self.retry_count += 1;\n                self.consecutive_race_lost += 1;\n                // The claim_span is dropped here, closing the bead.claim span.\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Retrying)?;\n            }\n            ClaimResult::NotClaimable { reason } => {\n                tracing::debug!(bead_id = %bead_id, %reason, \"bead not claimable\");\n                // Set the claim span result attribute\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.claim.result\", &reason);\n                // Set Error status on the claim span\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", &reason);\n                self.consecutive_race_lost = 0;\n                self.exclusion_set.insert(bead_id);\n                self.current_bead = None;\n                // The claim_span is dropped here, closing the bead.claim span.\n                self.set_state(WorkerState::Selecting)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// RETRYING: decide whether to retry claiming or move on.\n    ///\n    /// Tracks consecutive race_lost across retry cycles. When the count\n    /// exceeds `claim_race_lost_skip`, the worker treats the ready queue\n    /// as effectively empty and transitions to Exhausted instead of\n    /// spinning indefinitely on the same bead.\n    async fn do_retry(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let skip_threshold = self.config.worker.claim_race_lost_skip;\n\n        if self.consecutive_race_lost >= skip_threshold {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                consecutive_race_lost = self.consecutive_race_lost,\n                threshold = skip_threshold,\n                \"consecutive race_lost exceeded skip threshold, treating queue as exhausted\"\n            );\n            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ClaimRaceLostSkipped {\n                consecutive_losses: self.consecutive_race_lost,\n                threshold: skip_threshold,\n            })?;\n            self.consecutive_race_lost = 0;\n            self.retry_count = 0;\n            self.exclusion_set.clear();\n            self.race_lost_this_cycle.clear();\n            self.current_bead = None;\n            self.set_state(WorkerState::Exhausted)?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Exponential backoff: start at 100ms, doubling each time, capped at 5s.\n        // This ensures even the first retry has a small delay to prevent tight loops.\n        let backoff_ms = if self.consecutive_race_lost > 0 {\n            // For race-lost retries: 100ms, 200ms, 400ms, 800ms, 1600ms, 3200ms, 5000ms (capped)\n            std::cmp::min(\n                100 * (1u64 << (self.consecutive_race_lost - 1).min(5)),\n                5000,\n            )\n        } else {\n            // For other retries (e.g., max_claim_retries): 100ms minimum\n            100\n        };\n        tracing::debug!(\n            consecutive_race_lost = self.consecutive_race_lost,\n            backoff_ms,\n            \"backing off before retry\"\n        );\n        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(backoff_ms)).await;\n\n        if self.retry_count < self.config.worker.max_claim_retries {\n            self.set_state(WorkerState::Selecting)?;\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                retry_count = self.retry_count,\n                \"max claim retries exceeded, clearing retry state for next cycle\"\n            );\n            self.retry_count = 0;\n            self.consecutive_race_lost = 0;\n            self.exclusion_set.clear();\n            self.race_lost_this_cycle.clear();\n            // NOTE: Do NOT clear race_lost_exclusions here. Those have TTL-based\n            // expiration and must persist to prevent re-selecting the same bead\n            // that just lost a claim race. Clearing them would cause an infinite\n            // race-lost loop (see needle-aad8).\n            self.current_bead = None;\n            self.set_state(WorkerState::Selecting)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// BUILDING: construct prompt from claimed bead.\n    async fn do_build(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let bead = match self.current_bead {\n            Some(ref b) => b.clone(),\n            None => {\n                bail!(\"BUILDING state without current_bead — invariant violated\");\n            }\n        };\n\n        let build_ws = if is_workspace_unset(&bead.workspace) {\n            self.config.workspace.default.clone()\n        } else {\n            bead.workspace.clone()\n        };\n\n        let worker_name = self.worker_name.clone();\n        let prompt_builder = self.prompt_builder.clone();\n\n        // Wrap prompt building in timeout. The build operation can be slow for\n        // large workspaces with many learning files.\n        // Enforce minimum timeout to prevent indefinite hangs (issue needle-3igr).\n        const MIN_BUILDING_TIMEOUT_SECS: u64 = 60;\n        let timeout_secs = self\n            .config\n            .worker\n            .building_timeout\n            .max(MIN_BUILDING_TIMEOUT_SECS);\n        let timeout_dur = std::time::Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs);\n        let bead_id = bead.id.clone();\n        let heartbeat_bead_id = bead_id.clone();\n        let telemetry =
